name: Spray Days
storyline:
After years of sleeping in and letting life pass you by, your parents finally showed you the door. Maybe it's time to actually do something!

Start in a cramped cellar, work your way through sheds and garages, and build a painting business worthy of the biggest commissions around.
summary: Paint, restore, and customize worn-out objects in this satisfying spray painting simulator. Complete quirky commissions, upgrade your tools, expand your workshop, and grow your restoration business - solo or with friends in online co-op!
